headlines.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Zoetis Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
headlines.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Zoetis Inc. alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims the company made false statements about its Companion Animal segment products, including Librela, Simparica Trio, Apoquel, and Cytopoint, while failing to disclose weakening veterinarian adoption, market share losses to competitors, and FDA safety concerns. Investors who purchased Zoetis securities between January 14, 2025 and May 6, 2026 may be eligible to join the case.

headlines.title: ZTS Investors Have Opportunity to Lead Zoetis Inc. Securities Fraud Lawsuit with the Schall Law Firm
headlines.summary: The Schall Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Zoetis Inc. for alleged securities fraud, claiming the company made false and misleading statements regarding its products. The lawsuit alleges that Zoetis failed to disclose weakening prescription growth for Librela following FDA safety warnings about neurological complications in dogs, as well as market share losses for its Trio, Apoquel, and Cytopoint products. Investors who purchased securities between January 14, 2025 and May 6, 2026 are encouraged to join the case.

headlines.title: FDA Approves First Gene Therapy for Young Children with Sickle Cell Disease
headlines.summary: The FDA approved a supplemental indication for Casgevy (exagamglogene autotemcel), a CRISPR-based gene therapy, expanding its use to children aged 2 years and older with sickle cell disease or transfusion-dependent β thalassemia. The approval was granted in 53 days under the FDA's Commissioner's National Priority Voucher pilot program, based on clinical trial data showing efficacy in eliminating vaso-occlusive crises and achieving transfusion independence.

VRRM.summary: Robbins LLP filed a class action lawsuit against Verra Mobility Corporation (VRRM) on behalf of investors who purchased securities between February 24-May 26, 2026. The lawsuit alleges the company misled investors about its growth prospects and relationship with major customer Avis Budget Group. On May 26, 2026, Verra announced Avis terminated its contract and lowered financial guidance, causing the stock to plummet 71% from $13.08 to $3.85 per share. VRRM.title: Verra Mobility Corporation Class Action Lawsuit Seeks Recovery for Investors; August 4, 2026, Deadline - Contact Kessler Topaz Meltzer & Check, LLP
VRRM.summary: A securities fraud class action lawsuit has been filed against Verra Mobility Corporation for allegedly making materially false statements about its Commercial Services business growth and Avis Budget Group contract. The stock plummeted 70.6% on the news, and the CEO was subsequently terminated. VRRM.title: Hagens Berman Investigates Verra Mobility Corporation (VRRM) Following CEO Resignation Amid Investor Class Action
VRRM.summary: Hagens Berman is investigating Verra Mobility Corp. following CEO David Roberts' abrupt resignation after 12 years. The investigation centers on whether executives misled investors about the status of negotiations with Avis Budget Group. Verra's stock crashed 70% on May 27, 2026, after disclosing Avis's contract termination notice, wiping out $1.4 billion in shareholder value. The firm is seeking investors with losses and whistleblowers with non-public information.

RCAT.title: Red Cat’s Teal Drones Advances to Gauntlet II of Drone Dominance Program
RCAT.summary: Red Cat Holdings announced that its subsidiary Teal Drones Inc. has advanced to Gauntlet II of the Drone Dominance Program at Fort Carson, Colorado in August 2026. Teal was selected among 19 companies following the Phase 2 Qualifier at Camp Grayling, Michigan, where 49 companies competed with approximately 79 unique drones. The advancement validates Red Cat's mission-ready drone and robotic solutions for defense and national security applications.

GRND.summary: Johnson Fistel, PLLC announced an investigation into potential breaches of fiduciary duty by Grindr Inc.'s Board of Directors regarding their decision to terminate negotiations with the company's controlling stockholder. The investigation examines whether the Board's actions were consistent with duties owed to all stockholders, particularly minority holders, and whether these decisions impacted stockholder rights and control balance.

BMBOY.summary: Bimbo Bakeries USA announced a multi-year commitment to remove artificial colors, preservatives, and emulsifiers from its portfolio of iconic brands by 2028. The company will complete artificial color removal in occasional-consumption products by end of 2026, with major brands like Sara Lee, Oroweat, and Thomas' becoming free from artificial preservatives and emulsifiers by 2028. The combined entity aims to address supply chain security threats by enabling developers to patch vulnerabilities without upgrading or migrating code. Aikido announced it will provide backported fixes for critical vulnerabilities to the open source community, positioning itself as an alternative to vendor lock-in solutions.

ASAN.title: Cause + Effect Strategy and StackAI Announce Strategic Partnership to Deliver AI-Powered Transformation and Measurable Results for Businesses
ASAN.summary: Cause + Effect Strategy (CES) and StackAI announced a strategic partnership to help mid-market and enterprise organizations implement AI solutions end-to-end. CES will provide data strategy and systems integration expertise, while StackAI's no-code AI platform will serve as the orchestration layer. The partnership aims to accelerate time-to-value for enterprise AI implementations and address common barriers like data readiness gaps and adoption challenges.

WETO.title: Wetour Robotics (NASDAQ: WETO) Demonstrates Conductor Neural Wristband with Training Powered by Meta’s Open emg2pose Dataset to Advance Physical AI Human-Machine Interaction and future physical-world models
WETO.summary: Wetour Robotics (NASDAQ: WETO) unveiled a live demonstration of its Conductor sEMG neural wristband, which decodes muscle signals into real-time 3D hand pose and converts gestures to text commands. The technology, trained on Meta's open emg2pose dataset, is engineered for affordable on-device deployment using 8-channel sensors at 250 Hz. Wetour positions Conductor as part of its Orchestra platform to enable human-intent data collection for robotics and physical AI applications while maintaining privacy through edge processing.

NTNX.title: Nutanix and the North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics Partner to Expand Computer Science Access Across North Carolina
NTNX.summary: Nutanix has committed $250,000 to establish an endowed professorship at the North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics (NCSSM) to expand computer science education across the state. The funding will support teacher training and open-source STEAM curriculum, with a focus on reaching rural and underserved communities through NCSSM Connect, a virtual learning platform. Charles Robinson has been appointed as the Nutanix Endowed Professor of Computer Science.

JOYY.title: JOYY Recognized as “Most Honored Company” in Extel’s 2026 Asia Executive Team Survey

ZLNDY.title: Releasing Hopsworks 5.0 - Introducing the Coding Data and AI Stack
ZLNDY.summary: Hopsworks launched version 5.0, a unified AI and Data platform featuring embedded coding agents, development containers, and a redesigned UI. The platform is now generally available for both SaaS and enterprise deployments.

The appointment supports 707's strategic expansion into AI-powered blockchain-enabled supply-chain technologies.

WTW.title: WTW speeds strategic life insurer decisions with addition of GPU-support in RiskAgility Financial Modeller
WTW.summary: WTW announced GPU-support enhancements to its RiskAgility Financial Modeller platform for life and health insurers. BVVBY.title: BUREAU VERITAS - In line with the LEAP | 28 portfolio rotation strategy, Bureau Veritas signs an agreement to sell its Oil & Petrochemicals and Coal Testing and Inspection business
BVVBY.summary: Bureau Veritas has entered exclusive negotiations to sell its Oil & Petrochemicals and Coal testing and inspection business to Triton Partners for EUR 470 million as part of its LEAP | 28 portfolio rotation strategy. The business generated approximately EUR 450 million in revenue in 2025 but grew slower than the group and was margin dilutive. The transaction, expected to close by end of Q1 2027, represents approximately 20% portfolio rotation and will allow Bureau Veritas to redeploy proceeds toward higher-growth and higher-margin businesses.

BVVBY.summary: Bureau Veritas has entered into exclusive negotiations with Triton Partners to sell its petroleum products, petrochemicals, and coal testing and inspection business for €470 million. The divestment is part of the company's LEAP|28 portfolio rotation strategy to focus on higher-growth, higher-margin activities. The transaction, representing approximately 20% of the portfolio rotation, is expected to close by Q1 2027 and will be neutral to slightly positive for earnings while improving organic growth and operational margins.

MHGVY.summary: Mowi has agreed to divest its 9,000 GWT salmon farming operations in Canada East to Cooke Inc. for CAD 225 million on a debt-free basis. The transaction, expected to close in H2 2026, will reduce Mowi's 2026 volume guidance from 605k GWT to 600k GWT and result in a write-down of approximately CAD 140 million. The divestment is part of Mowi's strategy to improve its farming portfolio and focus on core geographies.

CALM.title: Cal-Maine Foods Reaches Resolution with U.S. Department of Justice and 17 States’ Attorneys General
CALM.summary: Cal-Maine Foods, the largest U.S. egg producer, has agreed to settle antitrust claims from the DOJ and 17 state attorneys general regarding alleged price manipulation through a cooperative. The company denies wrongdoing and faces no fines from the DOJ, but agreed to donate 30 million eggs and pay $1.5 million to states. Cal-Maine exited the cooperative in May 2024 and cooperated fully with the 15-month investigation.
